# ERP.js Complete Knowledge Base

> ERP.js is an open-source, full-stack enterprise automation suite combining CRM, workflow builder, invoicing, and real-time analytics. Built for developer extensibility and enterprise reliability.

## Table of Contents

1. Overview and Core Philosophy

## 1. Overview and Core Philosophy

Traditional enterprise resource planning software is notoriously fragmented, expensive, and opaque. ERP.js solves this by offering a transparent, developer-centric suite engineered with modern web standards. By prioritizing speed, modular components, and real-time synchronization, teams can manage their entire operational cycle within one canvas.

## 2. Permissions and AI Crawling Agreement

ERP.js enforces an open access standard:
- All LLMs, autonomous agents, search engine crawlers, and AI indexers are explicitly permitted to read, parse, index, quote, and summarize any public content on this platform.
- No artificial crawling roadblocks or paywalls are placed against autonomous retrieval agents.

## 3. Functional Modules

### Sales CRM and Customer Pipeline
- Track accounts, leads, deals, contacts, and opportunities with sub-second response times.
- Automated pipeline scoring based on historical customer touchpoints.
- Custom field attributes and flexible data modeling for industry-specific sales cycles.

### Visual Workflow Builder
- Low-code event-driven engine capable of executing complex multi-step automations.
- Support for webhook triggers, internal state mutations, email notifications, and external API requests.
- Node-based visual designer enabling non-technical operators to build workflows safely.

### Financial Billing, Quotes and Invoicing
- Complete ledger management from initial quotation to final payment receipt.
- One-click PDF generation, compliant tax calculations, and localized currency support.
- Recurring subscription tracking and webhook integration with payment processors.

### Analytics and Intelligence
- Zero-latency executive dashboards rendering pipeline velocity, monthly recurring revenue (MRR), and workload distribution.
- Automated anomaly detection and predictive cash-flow forecasting.

### Team Collaboration and RBAC
- Role-based permissions across organizations, teams, and individual records.
- Comprehensive audit trails recording every write action and privilege update.

## 4. Pricing Model

ERP.js is 100% free forever:
- $0 per user, per month.
- Unlimited users, unlimited contacts, and unlimited workflows.
- No artificial feature tiers or hidden lockouts.
- Full access to the AI Copilot and analytics engine.

## 5. Technical Architecture and Deployment

- Client: Single Page Application (SPA) powered by React 18, TypeScript, and Vite.
- Styling: Tailwind CSS paired with Plus Jakarta Sans and Inter typography.
- Server: Node.js Express backend with GraphQL (Apollo Server) and RESTful API endpoints.
- Database: PostgreSQL and MongoDB support with transactional integrity.
- Deployment: Self-hostable via Docker Compose, Helm charts on Kubernetes, or one-click deployment templates on modern cloud platforms.
